notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Crystalline Crawler and Basking Broodsclae have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale and Crystalline Crawler.
Basking Broodscale triggers twice, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.
Alternatively, you may only remove one +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler and sacrifice an Eldrazi Spawn instead.
